what: Dead after 01362 (cargo): the daemon no longer builds a proc macro natively or appends its __blaze_proc_macros list (blaze_macro_eval::load runs its MIR and finds its macros from the def map, blaze-macro-eval run.rs functions). So hir-ty-codegen v2 RootKind::ProcMacro, roots/proc_macros.rs (roots, MODULE, HirFrontend::proc_macro_list) and the proc_macro_list re-export in v2.rs have no caller. Delete them (one way per job); tell cargo and blaze-cargo serve/unit/codegen.rs root_kind drops its Makes::Shared { proc_macro: true } arm (cargo will make it an error naming that a proc macro builds no code). Also update the run.rs functions doc comment that names the list.

history.note: deleted hir-ty-codegen v2 RootKind::ProcMacro, roots/proc_macros.rs (with its MARK; harness appended_at now finds only the harness mark), the proc_macro_list re-export and the test a_proc_macro_crate_needs_to_be_one. Unbuilt; rust-analyzer down since the restart.
